metadata.subject: Enforceability of Automated Cross-Border Cashback Payouts and Personal Data Processing under Decree 13/2023/ND-CP

factual_background.summary: Shoppe Affiliate platform operates an automated affiliate cashback engine with multi-tier routing (PayOS automated payouts < 200,000 VND and VietQR human-in-the-loop routing >= 200,000 VND). The platform collects customer banking identifiers, phone numbers, and transaction logs, utilizing Singapore cloud infrastructure for auxiliary data warehousing.
documents_reviewed: PayOS Open Banking API Integration Agreement 2026
Affiliate Merchant Terms of Service v3.2
Cross-Border Cloud Service Level Agreement (AWS Singapore)
assumptions: All transaction records and bank account bindings are genuine and user-authorized via OTP
Payment gateway holds legitimate Payment Intermediary License from the State Bank of Vietnam
No classified state secrets or sensitive biometric data are transmitted or processed

legal_issues.question: Does the automated cashback distribution mechanism comply with Vietnamese non-cash payment regulations and Commercial Law 2005?
legal_issues.statutory_analysis: Under Decree 52/2024/ND-CP on non-cash payments and Commercial Law 2005 Article 88-92 on commercial promotions, cashback rewards structured as trade promotion discounts or sales incentives are legally permitted provided that total promotional value caps are complied with and payments are routed through licensed payment intermediary institutions or credit institutions.

legal_issues.question: Is the transfer of customer transaction and payout data to AWS Singapore compliant with Decree 13/2023/ND-CP Article 25?
legal_issues.statutory_analysis: Under Article 25 Decree 13/2023/ND-CP, the transfer of personal data of Vietnamese citizens abroad requires: (i) explicit opt-in consent of data subjects, (ii) formulation of an outbound data transfer impact assessment dossier (Form 06), (iii) storage of the dossier for inspection by the Department of Cybersecurity and Hi-tech Crime Prevention (A05 MPS), and (iv) written notification to A05 within 60 days of data transfer.

conclusion_and_opinion.executive_opinion: The automated cashback distribution model is legally viable and compliant with Vietnamese commercial law, subject to strict execution of statutory promotional registrations and immediate formalization of the Decree 13 Article 25 cross-border data transfer dossier.
conditions: Mandatory inclusion of explicit cross-border data processing consent checkboxes during user registration
Completion of Decree 13 Form 06 dossier submission to A05 MPS within 60 days
Preservation of immutable audit logs for all bank disbursement transactions for a minimum of 5 years
conclusion_and_opinion.risk_assessment: MEDIUM (Manageable with execution of recommended compliance action plan)

steps.action: Update PWA Terms of Service to embed granular Decree 13 opt-in consents for personal data processing and outbound transfer
Finalize and submit outbound data transfer impact assessment dossier to A05 MPS

It does not constitute representation in litigation before Vietnamese courts, arbitration before VIAC/SIAC, or external filings without corporate power of attorney.
